literal_meaning: গাল ভর্তি পান (cheeks full of paan)
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাড়িতে আত্মীয়রা এসেছে, তাই মায়ের হাতে গালভরা পান তৈরি হচ্ছে।
উৎসবে সবাই গালভরা পান খেয়ে আনন্দ করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Relatives have come home, so mother is preparing cheek-full paan.
At the festival, everyone is enjoying cheek-full paan with delight.
history: Paan chewing is a longstanding tradition in Bengali culture, often associated with social gatherings and hospitality, dating back to Mughal influences.
note: This idiom highlights the cultural practice of preparing generous portions of paan for guests.
